sections.heading: The moving pieces include more than crust
sections.body: Lithospheric plates include crust and the rigid uppermost mantle. They move slowly over the deeper mantle.
sections.visual: Plates are rigid pieces of lithosphere that ride over the deeper mantle. Highlight each plate to see that the moving unit is thicker than the crust alone.
sections.diagram: <svg viewBox="0 0 800 400" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" role="img" aria-label="Plates move over the mantle"><title>Plates move over the mantle</title><rect x="0" y="0" width="800" height="400" rx="16" fill="#101923"/><text x="28" y="35" fill="#e8ecf1" font-size="21" font-family="sans-serif">Plates move over the mantle</text><path d="M28 51 L772 51" fill="none" stroke="#344253" stroke-width="2"/><rect x="60" y="220" width="680" height="100" rx="8" fill="#172331" stroke="#344253"/><text x="400" y="280" fill="#9aa6b8" font-size="16" text-anchor="middle">Mantle</text><g class="lw-step"><rect x="80" y="140" width="160" height="80" rx="6" fill="#172331" stroke="#7cc7ff" stroke-width="2"/><text x="160" y="185" fill="#7cc7ff" font-size="16" text-anchor="middle">Plate A</text></g><g class="lw-step"><rect x="280" y="130" width="180" height="90" rx="6" fill="#172331" stroke="#7ee2a8" stroke-width="2"/><text x="370" y="180" fill="#7ee2a8" font-size="16" text-anchor="middle">Plate B</text></g><g class="lw-step"><rect x="500" y="145" width="200" height="75" rx="6" fill="#172331" stroke="#ffd479" stroke-width="2"/><text x="600" y="188" fill="#ffd479" font-size="16" text-anchor="middle">Plate C</text></g><path d="M28 350 L772 350" fill="none" stroke="#344253" stroke-width="2"/><text x="28" y="379" fill="#9aa6b8" font-size="15">Lithosphere = crust + uppermost mantle</text></svg>

sections.heading: Pull apart, push together, slide past
sections.body: Divergent boundaries pull apart, convergent boundaries push together, transform boundaries slide past.
sections.visual: Three relative motions: plates separate, collide, or slide past. The boundary type is about direction of motion, not how dramatic the landscape looks.
sections.diagram: <svg viewBox="0 0 800 400" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" role="img" aria-label="Three boundary types"><title>Three boundary types</title><rect x="0" y="0" width="800" height="400" rx="16" fill="#101923"/><text x="28" y="35" fill="#e8ecf1" font-size="21" font-family="sans-serif">Pull apart · push together · slide past</text><path d="M28 51 L772 51" fill="none" stroke="#344253" stroke-width="2"/><g class="lw-step"><text x="140" y="160" fill="#7cc7ff" font-size="18" text-anchor="middle">Divergent</text><path d="M80 220 L120 220" stroke="#7cc7ff" stroke-width="3" fill="none" class="lw-flow"/><path d="M160 220 L200 220" stroke="#7cc7ff" stroke-width="3" fill="none" class="lw-flow"/></g><g class="lw-step"><text x="400" y="160" fill="#7ee2a8" font-size="18" text-anchor="middle">Convergent</text><path d="M340 220 L380 220" stroke="#7ee2a8" stroke-width="3" fill="none"/><path d="M420 220 L460 220" stroke="#7ee2a8" stroke-width="3" fill="none"/></g><g class="lw-step"><text x="640" y="160" fill="#ffd479" font-size="18" text-anchor="middle">Transform</text><path d="M580 200 L700 200" stroke="#ffd479" stroke-width="3" fill="none"/></g><path d="M28 350 L772 350" fill="none" stroke="#344253" stroke-width="2"/><text x="28" y="379" fill="#9aa6b8" font-size="15">Boundary type sets the relative motion</text></svg>

sections.heading: Slow loading can release suddenly
sections.body: Stress builds along faults until rock slips. P waves travel faster than S waves from the focus.
sections.visual: From the focus, compressional P waves expand faster than shear S waves. Scrub the motion: the cyan P front stays ahead of the purple S front — that lag is the teaching point.
sections.diagram: <svg viewBox="0 0 800 400" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" role="img" aria-label="P waves outrun S waves"><title>P waves outrun S waves</title><rect x="0" y="0" width="800" height="400" rx="16" fill="#101923"/><text x="28" y="35" fill="#e8ecf1" font-size="21" font-family="sans-serif">P waves outrun S waves</text><path d="M28 51 L772 51" fill="none" stroke="#344253" stroke-width="2"/><circle cx="400" cy="210" r="8" fill="#ffd479"/><text x="400" y="195" fill="#ffd479" font-size="14" text-anchor="middle">Focus</text><circle class="lw-wave-p" cx="400" cy="210" r="40" fill="none" stroke="#7cc7ff" stroke-width="3"/><circle class="lw-wave-p-late" cx="400" cy="210" r="40" fill="none" stroke="#7cc7ff" stroke-width="2" opacity="0.5"/><circle class="lw-wave-s" cx="400" cy="210" r="40" fill="none" stroke="#b39dff" stroke-width="3"/><circle class="lw-wave-s-late" cx="400" cy="210" r="40" fill="none" stroke="#b39dff" stroke-width="2" opacity="0.5"/><text x="120" y="100" fill="#7cc7ff" font-size="18">P — faster, compressional</text><text x="120" y="130" fill="#b39dff" font-size="18">S — slower, shear</text><path d="M28 350 L772 350" fill="none" stroke="#344253" stroke-width="2"/><text x="28" y="379" fill="#9aa6b8" font-size="15">Scrub to compare wavefront speeds</text></svg>
